summary: Sandeep Bhalla (Regional Manager) introduced Xavier University (Cincinnati) to TOC counselors, emphasizing its Jesuit cura personalis values, an 11:1 student-faculty ratio with average class sizes of 23, and a $2.8 million NIH grant that placed Xavier among only six institutions in that inaugural cohort. On affordability, Bhalla stated that 100% of admitted international families receive a scholarship offer, with merit awards ranging $23,000-$36,000 per year, and that effective annual tuition after aid can fall as low as $11,500.
keyInsights: 11:1 student-to-faculty ratio, average class size ~23 students.
$2.8 million NIH research grant -- Xavier was one of only six institutions in that inaugural cohort.
Merit scholarships range $23,000-$36,000/year; effective tuition after aid can be as low as $11,500.
